consent.title: Yɛbɛtumi akora wo ho nsɛm so?
consent.body: Yɛbɛkora wo din, wo fon nɔma ne w'afuo ho nsɛm wɔ fon yi so na yɛde akɔma Aduane ne Kuadwuma Minisiteri (MoFA). Yɛde bɛsoma wo afotuo, nneɛma bo ne mmoa. Wobɛtumi aka akyerɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnsesa anaa yɛmpopa bere biara.
